# A clause id written as prose

`Policy: pol-SPAN` `DRAFT`

## Purpose

The id is right and reads identically once the table is rendered, which is exactly the problem: a code span is
what marks it as a handle rather than a word, and flattened text cannot tell the two apart.

## Scope

This fixture only. It exists so `clause-id-format` is exercised on its code-span branch — the mirror of the same
question the identity line settles for a document id.

## Clauses

| Id    | Clause                                               | Alignment |
|-------|------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| CLEAN | **MUST** trigger `clause-id-format` and nothing else |           |
